name: zeitkompass-hmv-portal
title: Zeitkompass HMV Portal
description: Record an incoming Rezept or Pflegeempfehlung, report the handover to the Versorgungspartner, report that the Medizinischer Dienst is involved, or record a Bewilligung - without leaving the mail client. Hands the work to the Zeitkompass Portal, which does the writing and confirms it on the claim.
author: alex_kuon

commands.name: report-document
commands.title: Report Received Prescription / Recommendation
commands.subtitle: Zeitkompass HMV Portal
commands.description: A Rezept or Pflegeempfehlung arrived by email or post. Creates the Antrag if there is none, records the document as received on the given date, and advances the Antragsphase.

commands.name: report-handover
commands.title: Report Distributor Handover
commands.subtitle: Zeitkompass HMV Portal
commands.description: The Antrag has gone to the Versorgungspartner. Creates the Antrag if there is none, sets the Antragsphase to "An Versorgungspartner übergeben" and records the day of the handover.

commands.name: report-md
commands.title: Report MD Involvement
commands.subtitle: Zeitkompass HMV Portal
commands.description: The Pflegekasse has the Medizinischer Dienst assess a filed Antrag. Moves it to "Wartet auf MD-Begutachtung" and attaches the MD. Not for an Antrag in a Widerspruch - there the review is tracked by the Widerspruch phase itself.

commands.name: report-approval
commands.title: Report Approval
commands.subtitle: Zeitkompass HMV Portal
commands.description: Die Pflegekasse hat bewilligt. Creates the Antrag if there is none and sets the Antragsphase to "Bewilligt". Records no documents - only the outcome.

preferences.name: portalUrl
preferences.title: Portal URL
preferences.description: Origin of the Zeitkompass Portal, e.g. https://portal.inclusys.de - no path.

preferences.name: locale
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Locale prefix for the portal's admin routes.
